purpose: First-party city cadastre and public map-catalog route review.
registryBasis: First-party municipal finance and technology agencies report managing the Teresina property cadastre and loading lots, blocks and buildings into their city GIS. Their January and October 2025 project notices explicitly bind the cadastral work to this municipality. They establish local cadastre activity, not present public parcel-vector availability.
technicalBlocker: The public municipal map catalog links an anonymous file folder containing blocks, neighborhoods, roads, urban perimeter and zoning archives; no parcel/lote archive is listed. City GIS project notices do not expose a public parcel feature schema or service. The property consultation form requires an existing inscription and has not been submitted. No full parcel polygon was obtained; blocks and zoning are not treated as parcels.
